questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has base 12cm and height 6cm. What is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is half base times height: 0.5 × 12 × 6 = 36cm². Forgetting to halve gives 72cm², a common mistake.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Romeo and Juliet, what is Juliet's last name?
questions.why: Juliet belongs to House Capulet, the family feuding with Romeo's House Montague.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is the male sex cell in animal reproduction called?
questions.why: Sperm is the male gamete; it fuses with the female gamete (egg) to form a zygote.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: In what year did the First Crusade begin?
questions.why: The First Crusade launched in 1096, called by Pope Urban II the year before in 1095.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: What is the volume of a cube with side length 4cm?
questions.why: Volume of a cube is side cubed: 4 × 4 × 4 = 64cm³. Squaring instead of cubing gives the wrong 16cm³.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A shape is made of a 6cm by 4cm rectangle plus a 6cm by 2cm rectangle. What is the total area?
questions.why: Add the two parts separately: 6×4=24cm² plus 6×2=12cm², giving 36cm² total. Missing one part gives 24cm².

questions.subject: Geography
questions.prompt: What term describes countries becoming more linked through trade and technology?
questions.why: Globalisation describes growing interconnection between countries through trade, technology, and communication.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Which European trading cities profited most from shipping crusader armies to the Holy Land?
questions.why: Venice and Genoa were Italian port cities that grew wealthy transporting and supplying crusader forces.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: Which acting company did Shakespeare belong to?
questions.why: Shakespeare belonged to The Lord Chamberlain's Men, later renamed The King's Men. The other names are invented and never existed as real Elizabethan companies.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: What poetic form is the Romeo and Juliet prologue written in?
questions.why: The prologue is a 14-line sonnet, setting up the play's tragic outcome before the action begins.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is a zygote formed from?
questions.why: A zygote forms when a sperm and egg (two gametes) fuse together during sexual reproduction.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: A classmate says medieval Europe was 'just chaos' with nothing organised after Rome fell, since there was no empire anymore. Explain what this misses about how feudalism and the Church actually structured society.
